newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CareMatrix started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CareMatrix started at buy.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said analyst Sheryl Skolnick had started coverage of CareMatrix Corp with a buy rating based on solid demand and low supply for assisted-living services.
-- Skolnick believes demand for private-pay assisted-living services is supported by the likelihood of 25 years of record growth in the number of and wealth of elderly people.

-- CareMatrix provides assisted living services through 20 facilities in eight states that have capacity for 1,580 residents. It is currently developing 28 more facilities with space for 4,000 residents.
